title: Arch-aware backend loader + threshold config
description: backend/app/ml/damage_inference.py: replace inline hardcoded EggGradingCNN-only construction with metadata-driven load — read arch/arch_args from checkpoint, build via model_factory ('resnet18' or 'custom'); checkpoints WITHOUT arch metadata fall back to 'custom' (backward compat with models/egg_grader.pth). Preserve BGR->RGB conversion, review band -> Needs Review, model_version from checkpoint metadata. backend/app/config.py: set DAMAGE_REVIEW_THRESHOLD from reports/damage_threshold.json selected_threshold. No behavior regression for existing keys damage_status/confidence/review_reason.
acceptance_criteria: Loader reads arch from checkpoint metadata and builds matching model (resnet18 + custom both)
Legacy checkpoint without arch metadata loads as custom (no crash)
BGR->RGB conversion intact; review band still yields Needs Review
